verdict.rationale: Rippling docs claim device-attribute-based security policies and automated threat workflows (docs-6, docs-7, docs-25), which could underlie posture-gated access, but no evidence explicitly ties device posture (managed/encrypted/screen-locked) checks into an auth policy gate before app session grant like a conditional-access flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional access enforcement at login/SSO based on device posture, named checks (encryption, screen-lock status), and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this gating behavior.
